summary.headline: Endurance Technologies Q2 FY27 consolidated income rose 33% YoY to ₹4,811 crore, with EBITDA margin at 12.1% and PAT up 21% to ₹274 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated income grew 33% YoY to ₹4,811 crore, EBITDA rose 17.3% to ₹584 crore (12.1% margin) and PAT rose 21% to ₹274 crore, helped by a ₹36 crore Stöferle step-acquisition gain and offset by a ₹31 crore accelerated depreciation charge in Europe. Standalone India EBITDA margin fell about 2 points to 10.5% as RMC rose to 70% of sales from 66%, because OEMs had not passed through fuel and cutting-tool cost increases in Q1-Q2. Management expects about 0.5% price pass-through from 1 October and a 0.5-0.6% commodity tailwind in Q3, and says the margin trajectory should improve. Order wins were ₹748 crore in H1 FY27, and the company is expanding into 4W castings, proprietary 4W systems, battery packs, solar and non-auto businesses.

financial_highlights.change: +94% YoY, +50% QoQ; PAT positive for consecutive quarters

segments.name: India standalone
segments.commentary: Total income ₹3,761 crore (+40% YoY), EBITDA ₹395 crore at 10.5% margin, up from ₹358 crore in Q1 FY27. Income mix in H1 was 76% India (incl. Maxwell) and 24% Europe.

segments.name: Europe
segments.commentary: Turnover €93.9 million (vs €88.7 million), EBITDA €16.7 million (vs €15.8 million), net result €5.2 million (vs €3.9 million). Net result includes a €3.1 million gain on the Stöferle buyout and ~€3 million accelerated depreciation on a Volkswagen Group project; cash flow €17.7 million.

segments.name: Maxwell (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue ₹85 crore (+95% YoY, +50% QoQ); H1 turnover ₹141 crore vs ₹161 crore for full FY26. Management targets double-digit margin next financial year.

segments.name: Battery packs / others
segments.commentary: SOP of EV battery packs for a leading 2W OEM, with full ramp-up expected in Q3 FY27; nominations from two PV OEMs with SOP in Q1 and Q2 FY28. Management says margins are decent but not yet disclosed.

guidance_outlook: Q3 FY27: customer price increase of about 0.5% of gross margin from 1 October; commodity basket about 0.5-0.6% positive; overall RMC% to sales expected to fall about 0.6% absolute in Q3.
Greenfield facilities (cumulative capex about ₹1,100 crore) had a ~0.5% negative PBT margin drag in Q2; expected to narrow and turn positive contribution in FY28.
Capex: India FY27 about ₹1,100 crore (FY26 ~₹800 crore); consolidated capex about ₹1,250 crore.
Maharashtra PSI incentive: ₹858 crore total (up from ₹600 crore); ₹75 crore booked in H1 FY27 and ~₹50 crore expected in H2 FY27.
Maxwell targets double-digit EBITDA margin in FY28.

Cumulative SOP targets: 4W suspension, brakes and driveshaft from ₹100 crore in FY28 to ₹800 crore in FY31; non-auto SOP from ₹250 crore in FY28 to ₹650 crore by FY31; proprietary 4W revenue above ₹1,500 crore by FY31 (management says achievable, not within two years).
capex_capacity: ABS capacity to reach 1.54 million units per annum by Q4 FY27, about 70% booked by Bajaj Auto and Royal Enfield; dual-channel ABS supply to Bajaj started October 2026.
New Chennai disc brake assembly plant SOP March 2027; Waluj brakes plant added 1 million units capacity for Hero MotoCorp and TVS (SOP Q2 FY27).
AURIC Shendra 4W casting plant SOP on 25 September 2026, serving Indian, UK and US OEMs; supplies to a US EV OEM have begun. Aluminium forging fifth press SOP in Q4 FY27.
Upside-down fork capacity to reach 100,000 units per month across seven OEM customers including exports by Q4 FY27.
Sanand solar damper plant ready: European client SOP started Q2; US client SOP in H2 FY27; solar actuator SOP Q4 FY27.
Battery pack line capacity cited as about 18,000 2W packs or 8,000 4W packs per month per line.
demand_pricing: Total H1 FY27 business win ₹748 crore (excluding Bajaj), largely HMSI, Tata Motors, Hero MotoCorp, TVS, Ather and a US EV OEM. Cumulative wins since FY22 ₹6,372 crore, of which ₹3,798 crore still to be realised; EV share 24% (11% in FY22); India 4W share 23.5% (16% in FY22).
Europe H1 FY27 order wins €28 million, including two Mercedes orders of €14 million (SOP 2029) and Stellantis €4 million and Mercedes €10 million (SOP 2027).
Bajaj Auto is excluded from order-win figures; management put Bajaj at about 35% of group income (H1 income ₹9,159 crore).
Management says EV revenue margin is broadly similar to the company average, with battery packs and BMS adding new revenue.

Management cites EU policy changes: a 350,000-unit cap on Chinese plug-in and mild hybrid imports from 1 December 2026, duties on Chinese BEVs (BYD 27%, Geely 29%, SAIC 45%), and a proposed 70% EU-origin content rule for non-battery EV components.

qa_highlights.question: How should gross margin in India be read, given commodity easing and conversion-cost pass-through?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said customers agreed to about 0.5% price increase from 1 October, plus a 0.5-0.6% commodity benefit; some customers may pass through in Q4 and others in FY28. Management said the commodity headwind appears largely behind it.

qa_highlights.question: Why diversify, and which non-auto areas are near term versus long term?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the strategy builds on die-casting and aluminium strengths. Engagements are advanced in power backup, robotics and railways; aviation and defence are under active consideration with indirect supply started. Most areas should see commercial production this year.

qa_highlights.question: What is the solar business's size, customer base, margin and asset turnover?
qa_highlights.answer: Two customers, in Spain and the US. Management targets ₹250 crore next year and ₹650 crore by FY31 across railways and solar; asset turnover expected above 8x because it is mostly assembly.

qa_highlights.question: What is Bajaj's share of revenue, and when does Maxwell reach double-digit margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Bajaj is about 35% of group income (H1 FY27 income ₹9,159 crore). Maxwell targets double-digit margin in the next financial year.

qa_highlights.question: What is the battery pack capacity and margin profile?
qa_highlights.answer: One 2W OEM reaches peak sales this quarter; two 4W nominations start around March/April 2027 and Q2 FY28. Management says margins are decent and ROCE is good, but gave no figure.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Fondalpress acquired, and what are the synergies?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Fondalpress is a former competitor with about €80 million turnover in 2017 and 16 die-casting machines (2,300-2,800 ton), 16,400 sq m of buildings, and €10.2 million cash. The purchase price was €12.3 million; it will insource Stöferle castings and enable truck and Stellantis transmission housings.

qa_highlights.question: Can four-wheeler order wins of about ₹1,500 crore translate into revenue, and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the proprietary 4W products (driveshaft, brakes, suspension, battery packs) could cross ₹1,500 crore by FY31; the won orders are expected to convert over about two years, and the figure includes casting only in the broader context.

qa_highlights.question: Will EV mix dilute corporate margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said EV margins are similar to the company average and aim to improve them; with the new battery pack business, EV is margin-accretive overall.

risks_watch: Gross margin recovery depends on customer price pass-through: about 0.5% from 1 October is agreed by only some customers, others may pass through in Q4 or FY28.
Standalone RMC at 70% of sales (vs 66%) and whether the expected ~0.6% absolute RMC reduction in Q3 materialises, given management expects steel to rise.
Greenfield facilities (~₹1,100 crore cumulative capex) carried about a 0.5% negative PBT margin drag in Q2; watch whether the drag narrows and turns positive in FY28.
Proprietary 4W revenue target above ₹1,500 crore by FY31 and whether driveshaft, brake, suspension and battery pack SOPs hit the timelines given (several are H1 FY28 or later).
Europe: Stöferle integration, Fondalpress ramp-up, ~€3 million accelerated depreciation on a Volkswagen Group project, and whether EU import caps and local-content rules lift volumes.
Maxwell double-digit EBITDA margin target for FY28 and battery pack margins, which management has not disclosed.
key_quotes: Overall, as of now, we see an absolute 0.6% lowering of RMC percentage to sales in Q3.
So, what I would like to highlight here is that we are seeing that the commodity headwind seems to be largely behind as we stand, and we expect the margin trajectory to improve from here on.
But when you ask me to put a number , it could be what I told you - by FY31 crossing ₹ 1,500 crores for the proprietary.
But of course, margins would be decent. And of course, once we start, our focus is to increase our margins.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on order flow, EV and non-auto diversification and the Q3 margin recovery, but was cautious and non-specific on numbers, declining to give battery pack margins, non-auto mix to 2030 and a firm non-auto revenue figure. Price pass-through and commodity benefits were presented as only partly agreed with customers.

growth.why: Management guides to ~₹1,100 crore standalone FY27 capex (up from ~₹800 crore) and ~₹1,250 crore consolidated, with ABS capacity to 1.54 million units by Q4 FY27 (~70% booked by Bajaj and Royal Enfield) and H1 order wins of ₹748 crore; no explicit revenue growth % guided, and margin recovery depends on a ~0.5% price pass-through and commodity tailwind from Q3.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Standalone EBITDA margin fell about 2 points to 10.5% as RMC rose to 70% of sales from 66%; management expects ~0.5% price increase from 1 October plus 0.5-0.6% commodity benefit, cutting RMC about 0.6% absolute in Q3, though part of the pass-through is still only agreed by some customers.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: ABS capacity rises to 1.54 million units per annum by Q4 FY27 (about 70% booked by Bajaj and Royal Enfield), the Chennai disc brake plant has SOP in March 2027, and the aluminium forging fifth press SOPs in Q4 FY27.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 FY27 order wins of ₹748 crore (excluding Bajaj), with cumulative wins of ₹6,372 crore since FY22 of which ₹3,798 crore is still to be realised; India EV sales rose 185% YoY to ₹229 crore; no explicit volume % guided.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex is already raised to about ₹1,100 crore standalone and ₹1,250 crore consolidated for FY27 (vs ~₹800 crore in FY26), with the new projects being built out; utilisation level was not disclosed, so a fresh announcement is probable rather than certain.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Maharashtra PSI incentive rises to ₹858 crore total with ₹75 crore booked in H1 and about ₹50 crore expected in H2 FY27, and Maxwell's margin is targeted to turn double-digit in FY28, but no revenue or margin guidance raise was made.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Standalone RMC is at 70% of sales (vs 66%) and the Q3 RMC reduction depends on pass-through that only some customers agreed to, while management expects steel prices to rise; greenfield plants carry about a 0.5% negative PBT margin drag in Q2.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Battery pack SOP ramp for a leading 2W OEM completes in Q3 FY27, two PV OEM battery pack nominations start Q1-Q2 FY28, and the Sanand solar actuator SOP is in Q4 FY27 with US solar SOP in H2 FY27.

rows.label: Proprietary 4W and non-auto SOP ramp to FY31
rows.why: Targets are 4W SOPs of ₹100 crore in FY28 rising to ₹800 crore in FY31, non-auto SOP of ₹250 crore in FY28 rising to ₹650 crore by FY31, and proprietary 4W above ₹1,500 crore by FY31, though management says this is not achievable within two years.

rows.label: EU import caps and local-content rules
rows.why: A 350,000-unit cap on Chinese plug-in and mild hybrid imports starts 1 December 2026 and duties on Chinese BEVs apply, which management says could lift European volumes, but the impact is not quantified.

rows.label: Maxwell double-digit EBITDA margin
rows.why: Maxwell revenue reached ₹85 crore in Q2 (+94% YoY) and PAT has been positive for consecutive quarters, with management targeting double-digit EBITDA margin in FY28.

tone.note: Management was confident on order flow, EV and non-auto diversification, and the Q3 margin recovery, but cautious on battery pack margins and non-auto targets, and analysts pushed on price pass-through and the timing of the proprietary 4W ramp.
